number_of_tools.description: The total number of tools managed by the tool changer

use_clamp_register.description: If true, the system will use the clamp register to control tool clamping behavior. If false, clamp control will rely on the coil instead (the old setup).

check_clamp_pressure.description: If true, the system will validate the clamp pressure after clamp open or close.

pressure_timeout_s.description: Time in seconds to wait before timeout due to pressure issues

required_clamp_pressure.description: The required pressure for the clamp to hold the tools securely

min_clamp_pressure_reg_value.description: The minimum register value for clamp pressure

max_clamp_pressure_reg_value.description: The maximum register value for clamp pressure

min_clamp_pressure_psi.description: The minimum PSI value the clamp pressure can reach

max_clamp_pressure_psi.description: The maximum PSI value the clamp pressure can handle

use_payload_double_check.description: Specifies whether to perform a double check of the payload.

no_tool_payload.description: Specifies the payload value when no tool is attached

tool_payload_list.description: Specifies the payload values for each attached tool.

payload_tolerance.description: Specifies the tolerance level for payload measurements

behavior_type.description:
Defines the tool change behavior strategy:
  - 0 → Use proximity sensor-based tool change (default).
  - 1 → Use AFD-based tool change.

end_effector_max_extension.description: Maximum AFD position reading (in mm) when the end effector is fully extended (e.g., 20 mm). Will only take effect if behavior_type is set to 1 (AFD-based tool change).

contact_detection_threshold.description: Deviation threshold (in mm) in AFD readings used to detect contact—either tool presence on the robot or inside the bucket. Will only take effect if behavior_type is set to 1 (AFD-based tool change).

bucket_driven.description: If true, bucket identity will take priority over tool ID during tool matching

bucket_setup.description: Defines the logical layout of buckets and their assigned tools.

tool_id.description: Index or ID of the tool assigned to this bucket

max_consumption.description: Maximum number of pickups allowed before the bucket must be replenished.
